agyos_skill.instructions: A production-grade engineering runbook for diagnosing and repairing visual, temporal, physical, anatomical, and acoustic defects in AI-generated video media (specifically Google Flow and Veo), using a hybrid workflow of generation-time prompting and Linux CLI tools. - **Target Objective**: Improve visual fidelity, temporal stability, anatomical accuracy, physics plausibility, and audio clarity. - **Out-of-Scope**: Circumventing cryptographic provenance (C2PA), attempting to strip Google DeepMind SynthID neural watermarks, or falsifying camera sensor authenticity. SynthID operates within latent diffusion tensors and cannot be stripped by post-processing without destroying signal integrity. Always declare synthetic media in compliance with platform guidelines (e.g. YouTube Altered Content). - **The Filter Limit**: No post-processing CLI filter can construct non-existent hand anatomy, resolve impossible room geometry, or fabricate authentic human expression transitions. - **Decision Hierarchy**: 1. *Major Structural Defects* (extra limbs, morphing faces, impossible physics): **Regenerate in Google Flow** using consistent reference frames and targeted editing prompts. 2. *Localized Artifacts & Text Errors*: **Mask and inpaint** using ProPainter or composite graphic overlays. 3. *Global Technical Defects* (luminance flicker, camera jitter, color banding, noisy audio): **Filter programmatically** via FFmpeg, VidStab, and DeepFilterNet. Frame-by-frame enhancements (e.g. naive static image upscaling or per-frame face sharpening) introduce temporal boiling, shimmering edges, and phase chatter across adjacent frames. All CLI pipelines in this toolkit use temporal windowing, optical flow guidance, or multi-frame propagation. | Tool | Primary Function | Execution Context | Key Advantage | |---|---|---|---| | **FFmpeg + FFprobe** | Filtering, remuxing, deflicker, deband, loudness | Linux CPU / NVENC | Industry foundation; zero quality loss on copy remuxing | | **VidStab (FFmpeg)** | Two-pass camera stabilization | Linux CLI | Eliminates irregular generative camera wobble | | **CodeFormer** | Face detail restoration | Python / PyTorch (GPU) | Adjustable fidelity parameter (`-w`) prevents identity drift | | **Real-ESRGAN / Video2X** | Super-resolution video upscaling | Vulkan / PyTorch | Temporal video models minimize frame flickering | | **ProPainter / SAM 2** | Dual-domain flow-guided video inpainting | Python / PyTorch (CUDA) | Fills masked regions using optical flow propagation | | **DeepFilterNet 3** | Deep-learning speech enhancement | Rust CLI (`deep-filter`) | Low-latency, full-band (48kHz) speech denoising | | **Demucs (v4)** | Music & speech stem separation | Python / PyTorch | Isolate clean dialogue from muddy generative music | | **whisper.cpp** | Speech-to-text subtitle generation | C/C++ CLI | Fast, local execution generating synchronized `.srt` tracks | | **PySceneDetect** | Automated cut and shot boundary detection | Python CLI | Isolates damaged generative shots for targeted triage | | **VMAF (libvmaf)** | Objective perceptual video quality scoring | FFmpeg Filter | Measures structural degradation against source references | This matrix pairs the 11 defect categories from `ai-video-detection-forensics` with verified repair methods. - **Principle Focus**: File custody, digital origin, manifest records. - **Improvement Strategy**: Maintain untouched archive copies. Store source files with SHA-256 hashes. For visible corner indicator marks, apply spatial inpainting via `scripts/remove_flow_watermark.py`. Preserve C2PA metadata integrity through `c2patool`. - **Principle Focus**: Container atoms, variable frame rates, missing stream headers.
